name: Ultralight White Oak Slats, Oatmeal Felt
summary: White oak real-wood veneer laminated onto 9mm recycled oatmeal acoustic felt, with no MDF or rigid core. The oatmeal felt shows in the grooves between the slats.

texture.note: Manufacturer spec sheet overrides photo estimates: seven 1.20 in faces on a 1.69 in pitch with 0.49 in, 90-degree V-grooves cut 6.2 mm into 9 mm felt; seven exact pitches span 11.83 in rather than the listed 11.80 in panel width. The seamless tile is 23.66 in tall, with pale white-oak veneer and oatmeal felt colors taken from the main listing photo; no MDF or rigid core.
